(1) As a user, I want to search for products by name so that I can find what I'm looking for quickly.

parsed.body:
1. As a user, I want to search for products by name so that I can find what I'm looking for quickly.

2. As a user, I want the system to show me my recent orders and recommend similar products based on my purchase history so that I can discover items I might want to buy again.

3. As a user, I want to see real-time inventory levels from all warehouse locations when I click on a product and be able to reserve items for up to 24 hours so that I can ensure the items I need are available before I finalize my purchase.
